title: 가족 이야기: 누구를 돌보고, 어떤 날을 챙겨요?
objective: You can use 9 family words in short everyday sentences.
summary: Nine intermediate words for family relationships, caring for family, and family events.

task.title: Use the family words
task.line: Read each item, then choose, write or judge the word that fits the situation.

words.meaning: to look after, take care of (a child, a sick person)
words.example: 저희 부부가 출근하면 어머니가 아이를 돌봐 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: When my husband and I go to work, my mother looks after our child.

words.meaning: to live with and care for (an elderly parent); honorific
words.example: 할머니를 집에서 모시는 게 쉽지 않아요.
words.exampleMeaning: It is not easy to care for Grandma at home.

words.meaning: to be good to one's parents, show respect and care
words.example: 돈보다 자주 전화드리는 게 효도하는 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: Calling them often matters more than money; that is how you are good to your parents.

words.meaning: dual income; both spouses working (e.g. 맞벌이 부부 = a dual-income couple)
words.example: 저희는 맞벌이라서 저녁 준비를 같이 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: We both work, so we make dinner together.

words.example: 아기가 생긴 뒤로 육아 때문에 잠을 잘 못 자요.
words.exampleMeaning: Since the baby came, I can't sleep well because of childcare.
Our daughter-in-law is a really good cook.
My parents cherish their son-in-law like their own son.
I was invited to my friend's daughter's first-birthday party.

words.example: 올해 아버지 환갑이라서 가족 여행을 가기로 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It's my father's 60th birthday this year, so we decided to take a family trip.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 누나가 결혼해서 부모님께 ( 사위 / 며느리 )가 생겼어요. ② 형이 결혼해서 부모님께 ( 사위 / 며느리 )가 생겼어요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: ① 아내와 저는 둘 다 회사에 다녀요. 우리는 ____ 부부예요. ② 아이가 태어나서 남편이 1년 동안 ____ 휴직을 했어요.
Which family event is it? Write one word: ① 아기가 태어난 지 1년이 됐어요. 가족과 친구들을 불러서 잔치를 해요. ② 어머니가 올해 만 예순 살이 되셨어요. 온 가족이 모여서 축하해요.
Write the verb in the right form: ① 아이가 열이 나서 오늘은 회사에 안 가고 아이를 ____ 거예요. (돌보다) ② 부모님이 연세가 많으셔서 제가 ____ 살려고 해요. (모시다)
Answer in one Korean sentence using 효도하다: 부모님께 어떻게 효도하고 싶어요?
answers: (Sample answer) 부모님을 자주 찾아뵙고 같이 여행을 다니면서 효도하고 싶어요.
